anti_overlap: Does not evaluate Notion DB relations or property types (fd-notion-architecture)
Does not evaluate PRD acceptance criteria quality (fd-prd-craft)
Does not evaluate multi-project capacity or prioritization strategy (fd-multi-project-portfolio)
decision_lens: Would `bd list --label='project:X'` in the portfolio repo return well-structured, non-duplicated, correctly-prioritized initiatives that give an agent accurate cross-project context?
focus: Audit the beads issue tracking design for label convention correctness, epic/task/feature hierarchy integrity, dependency graph validity, and portfolio-to-per-project linkage patterns.
name: fd-beads-semantics
persona: Apply the perspective of a beads power user managing a multi-repo portfolio — they care about whether label schemas are consistent across repos, whether epics correctly parent tasks, whether dep edges create undetectable cycles, and whether portfolio-level issues have sufficient metadata to roll up to cross-project views without manual enrichment.
review_areas: Check whether the CUJ's `bd list --label='project:Sylveste'` pattern requires a label convention that is formally specified in the schema design — and flag if it's only assumed.
Evaluate the portfolio-beads → per-project beads linkage model: are cross-references stored as beads custom fields, or only as prose in description fields?
Assess whether the 27 imported initiatives in portfolio/.beads have consistent label structures that make the sync script's transformation deterministic.
Review whether F1 schema design specifies `bd lint` rules for mandatory fields on initiative issues, or relies on convention enforcement alone.
Check the roadmap's bead IDs (ideagui-is9, ideagui-2bm, ideagui-o5p) for consistent naming conventions and verify they're used consistently across docs.
Identify whether the 'agents do not run bd create in portfolio' social convention has any technical backstop or audit trail mechanism planned.

severity_examples.condition: If label conventions aren't canonicalized in schema.md, slicing breaks silently when the first real query runs.
severity_examples.scenario: The `project:X` label convention used in the agent CUJ happy path is not specified as part of F1 schema design, so sync script author and agent authors will diverge on label format.

severity_examples.condition: If cross-reference fields aren't typed in the schema, they become free-text and lose queryability.
severity_examples.scenario: Portfolio-to-per-project cross-references are described as 'source beads ID' in the CUJ but no field type or storage mechanism is specified for the Initiatives DB.

severity_examples.condition: Implicitly-done work not formally closed creates inaccurate completion metrics.
severity_examples.scenario: Roadmap references `ideagui-10v` as 'Done implicitly' without closing the bead, leaving the portfolio-beads in a partially-complete state.

success_hints: Label schema for `project:X`, `domain:X`, and priority is formally documented in schema.md
Cross-project reference fields have explicit types (not free-text) in the Initiatives DB spec
bd lint rules for mandatory initiative fields are specced before the sync script is written
All roadmap bead IDs reference real open/closed beads rather than placeholders
task_context: The ideagui foundation uses beads as the canonical execution layer, with portfolio/.beads holding 27 imported initiatives that will seed the Notion Initiatives DB. The review goal is to identify label convention gaps, hierarchy issues, and missing enforcement that would make the portfolio queryable-in-theory but unreliable-in-practice.
